title: The fixed untwisted comparison from raw resolution section cohomology to open cohomology.
statement:
The fixed untwisted comparison from raw resolution section cohomology to open cohomology. For all objects and arguments in the following signature, using [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], [def-sc-open-module-cohomology].

def resolutionOpenComparison {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ)
    (W : T.Opens) (R : RestrictedResolutionSections I (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)) :
    (sectionCohomologyPresheaf
      (((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex) q).obj (op W) ≃+
      (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme.toRingedSpace q ⊤).obj
        ((restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj F)
